question: According to Chart TF-G, around what year did the US Highway Trust Fund have outlays exceeding receipts between the fiscal years 1987-1991?
raw_response:
I can see the chart clearly. The solid Receipts line peaks ~17 in 1989, then drops to ~15.1 at 1990, where the dashed Outlays line (~15.3) crosses just above it. So Outlays exceeded Receipts around 1990.

The Receipts line dips to its lowest at 1990 and the dashed Outlays line is slightly above it at that point — the crossover where outlays exceed receipts occurs around 1990.

<FINAL_ANSWER>1990</FINAL_ANSWER>
